title: Budget
subtitle: Your shopping expenses month after month, and the cost of your meals.

month.title: This month
month.no-target: No target set for the month.
month.count: {count} visit to a shop | {count} visits to a shop

settings.title: Target and usual shop
settings.target-hint: Leave empty to set no target.
settings.target-invalid: The target must be more than zero.
settings.store-hint: Its prices give the cost of the meals. Empty: the lowest price of each food.

check: For {count} shopping plan, the application estimated {estimated} and you paid {paid}. | For {count} shopping plans, the application estimated {estimated} and you paid {paid}.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.empty: No expense yet. In a shopping plan, "I did this shopping" stores one.
expenses.store-hint: Choose a shop or type another name, for example "market".
expenses.amount-invalid: The amount must be more than zero.

record.title: I did this shopping
record.help: The expense goes into your budget. Replace the estimate with the amount of the receipt if you have it.
record.no-estimate: No estimate for this shop: type the amount that you paid.
record.existing: Already stored for this plan: {amount} at {store}, on {date}.

meals.title: Cost of the meals
meals.help: The cost of the quantities that each meal uses, without the rest of the packs.
meals.partial: {priced} ingredient of {total} has a price | {priced} ingredients of {total} have a price

recipes.title: Cost of the recipes
recipes.help: The cheapest serving first. A recipe appears when half of its ingredients have a price.
recipes.empty: No recipe has enough prices yet. In a shopping plan, search the products in the shops to get them.
recipes.counted: {priced} recipe of {total} has a cost | {priced} recipes of {total} have a cost
